reason: Raw beta variability has a component-count-dependent upper range. The audit asks whether the within-island hierarchy remains visible using pairwise correlation and a simple beta-excess normalization.

diagnostics.raw_normalized_excess_beta: (beta - 1) / (n_units - 1), computed separately for each eligible island and for the three island totals
diagnostics.pairwise_correlation: mean and median Pearson correlation among component trajectories, compared among islands versus within each eligible island

directional_checks.pairwise_synchrony: each eligible island mean pairwise correlation < among-island mean pairwise correlation for every fixed signal

interpretation_boundary: post-hoc robustness diagnostic, not a preregistered endpoint
pairwise correlation is a component-count comparability check, not a replacement for the exact Wang-Loreau decomposition
colony codes remain census units rather than GIS polygons
